info.name: Backend MetaU
info.description:
## Backend MetaU

This collection centralizes all HTTP requests for the **MetaU** academic management platform, organized as a set of independent microservices. It covers the full backend surface of the system, from authentication to billing, and is intended for development, integration testing, and API exploration.

### Microservices included

| Microservice | Responsibilities |
|---|---|
| **MicroservicioLogin** | Authentication: login, token refresh, and token validation |
| **MicroservicioUsuarios** | User management (CRUD) |
| **MicroservicioRoles** | Role definition and assignment |
| **MicroservicioInstituciones** | Institution management |
| **MicroservicioProfesores** | Teacher records management |
| **MicroservicioCarreras** | Academic program (career) management |
| **MicroservicioCursos** | Course management |
| **MicroservicioPeriodos** | Academic period management |
| **MicroservicioGrupos** | Group management per course/period |
| **MicroservicioModulos** | Module management |
| **MicroservicioDirecciones** | Geographic reference data (provinces, cantons, districts) |
| **MicroservicioExpedientesEstudiantes** | Student academic file management |
| **MicroservicioHistorialAcademico** | Academic history retrieval |
| **MicroservicioMatriculas** | Enrollment management |
| **MicroservicioPreMatriculas** | Pre-enrollment management |
| **MicroservicioListaEstudiantes** | Student list retrieval |
| **MicroservicioNotas** | Grade breakdown and rubric management |
| **MicroservicioNotificaciones** | Email notification dispatch |
| **MicroservicioFacturacion** | Invoice creation, retrieval, and cancellation |
| **MicroservicioPagos** | Payment processing and reversal |
| **MicroservicioParametros** | System parameter configuration |
| **MicroservicioBitacoras** | Audit log recording and retrieval |

### Environment
This collection uses the **MicroserviciosBaseUrls** environment, which provides the base URL variable for each microservice. Make sure this environment is active before sending requests.

Authentication relies on a bearer token obtained through the **MicroservicioLogin** endpoints. The token is stored in the `access_token` global variable and should be referenced as `{{access_token}}` in secured requests.
